sessions_root.description: Codex rollout session root. The default expands to the current user's ~/.codex/sessions.

target_umo.description: AstrBot unified message origin used for notifications. Leave empty to disable notifications until configured.

process_grace_seconds.description: Grace period before reporting a vanished Codex process.

notify_task_complete.description: Notify when a task_complete event is recorded.

notify_unexpected_stop.description: Notify on abnormal abort events or vanished Codex processes.

ignore_human_interrupt.description: Ignore turn_aborted events whose reason is interrupted.
